{{Quote|You've never been to Annaj, Miss Towani, but trust me&ndash;only someone doing time on the Endor Moon could find it interesting.|Hume Tarl|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Annaj''', known as '''Cannij Barr''' by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Zuma Region]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].

==History==
Annaj was a fog-covered globe colonized by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], the region's dominant species.<ref name="TEA" />

Discovered by [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists circa [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], the Moddell sector joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a freestanding subsector in [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]] during its warning [[Standard year/Legends|years]], with Annaj as its [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Located at the intersection of the two only [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connecting the sector with the rest of [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]] and the [[Moddell Reach]], the world was the first stop for all the ships crossing this remote region.<ref name="TEA" />

After its [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]], the sector fell to the [[Imperial Era/Legends|rule]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which Annaj served as a staging area for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Becoming a boomworld briefly during the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], it was eyed carefully by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] leaders. Immediately after the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] ordered the defeated Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to retreat to Annaj, which was nearly two days distance traveling at Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] speeds. The fleet spent several days regrouping and repairing at the planet.<ref name="TTB" />

As the struggling Imperial forces withdrew from the sector, the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]'s military leaders believed that the [[Unrepentant (Imperial-class)|''Unrepentant'']], an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], had acquired vital military data and then jumped to report to Imperial agents on Annaj. Eventually the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] routed Imperial bases on Annaj.<ref name="TTB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The in-game encyclopedia entry for Annaj in the PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] describes Annaj as a large [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. This is contradictory to other sources. This error was later reconciled in the world's entry in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which describes it as a "fog-covered globe."
Page 188 of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' spells Cannij Barr "Cannij Bar."
